notes:
2026-10-27 release review: Add source-image reconstruction, sticker/meme composition and still-image motion methods.

2026-10-27 release review: Turn supplied-image requests into faithful, reviewable outputs through the existing graphic owners.

2026-10-27 release review: Retain MIT adaptations from MixMatter 3.0.0, copyright Fan Jiale, with its original grant. Add visual-grammar and reconstruction references, a first-party Pillow composer and tests, still-image motion guidance and specialist policies. Built-in image editing follows the host tool instructions; true local cutouts require source alpha or a supplied mask.

Compatibility: 2026-10-27 release review: Existing graphic routes remain. The new local composition route does not require an external service; unavailable video capability yields an honestly labeled production brief. Source identity, approved assets and project brand remain authoritative.

Upgrade: 2026-10-27 release review: Refresh the package and select the matching supplied-image method. Install only its documented local dependencies if using the composer, and inspect saved outputs before delivery.

Validation: 2026-10-27 release review: The release scope record and current public/canonical source differences were reviewed read-only for this note. Applicable added specialist policy files were checked for allow_implicit_invocation: false. Package structural, provenance/license closure, focused runtime tests, privacy checks and publication readback remain release-gate checks; this note does not claim those checks passed or establish live runtime readiness. Read-only local_sync.reviewed_additions passed for all 16 listed exact-canonical additions, checking public/canonical byte equality, source-inventory membership, provenance hashes and license coverage. This does not establish full package or runtime validation.
